records.context: Cellpose predicts, per pixel, a flow toward the centre of the object the pixel belongs to. Timeflows adds the same idea through time: per pixel of frame ``t``, where the centre of that object is in frame ``t+1``, and whether it has a successor at all (cells die, divide, leave the microscope field of view). records.source: Cellpose predicts, per pixel, a flow toward the centre of the object the pixel belongs to. Timeflows adds the same idea through time: per pixel of frame ``t``, where the centre of that object is in frame ``t+1``, and whether it has a successor at all (cells die, divide, leave the field). Linking objects between frames then reads the model instead of guessing from overlap, which is where the plain IoU stitcher fails: fast cells that move more than their own size between frames (the MuSC movies move 3-4 diameters per frame at p95).
records.translation: Cellpose는 픽셀마다 그 픽셀이 속한 객체의 중심을 향하는 흐름을 예측합니다.
